trends.what: A curated directory of hundreds of free public APIs for developers to use in their projects.
trends.why: It's a go-to resource for developers looking to quickly find and integrate third-party services, and its massive star count reflects its enduring utility.

trends.what: An open-source platform offering free coding lessons, projects, and certifications in web development, data science, and more.
trends.why: It remains a top destination for self-taught programmers, and its constant updates and community contributions keep it relevant and widely shared.

trends.what: A massive collection of freely accessible programming books, tutorials, and learning resources in multiple languages.
trends.why: It's a treasure trove for cost-conscious learners, and its sheer volume and organization make it a trending bookmark for developers at all levels.

trends.what: A personal AI assistant that runs on any OS and platform, designed to be your always-available digital helper.
trends.why: The idea of a universal, self-hosted AI assistant resonates with the growing demand for privacy-focused, cross-platform automation tools.

trends.what: Interactive visual roadmaps and guides that outline learning paths and career progression for software developers.
trends.why: It helps developers navigate the overwhelming amount of tech knowledge, and its visual, step-by-step approach is highly shareable and practical.

trends.what: A tool that makes AI agents adopt a 'lazy senior dev' mindset, prioritizing minimal, efficient code over over-engineering.
trends.why: It taps into the developer humor and the real-world desire for simpler, more maintainable code, making it a viral hit among coders.

trends.what: A full-screen, mouse-interactive terminal UI and harness for running coding agents, designed for extensibility and developer control.
trends.why: It offers a fresh, immersive way to interact with AI coding tools, appealing to developers who want a more powerful and customizable terminal experience.

trends.what: A pure C, zero-dependency runtime that runs large mixture-of-experts AI models on consumer hardware by streaming experts from disk.
trends.why: It democratizes access to frontier AI models, letting hobbyists run powerful models without expensive GPUs, which is a hot topic in the AI community.
